$comment: Frozen-surface registry. always[] is the unrecoverable baseline (env, evidence record, witnesses) and is hard-BLOCKed by guard_frozen.py. Lockfiles are NOT in always[] - they WARN mid-flight (FR-ASR-08). Project surfaces[] are NOT blocked mid-flight; guard_commit blocks an UNDECLARED change to a matching path at commit (FR-ASR-05). Populate 'surfaces' for YOUR project during /company-init or /onboard. Changes to frozen surfaces go through company/change-requests/.
